title: Chapters
noChapters: No chapters yet. Create one to start working.
noNarrator: No narrator yet for this chapter.
forkAtMessageAlert: Forking from a specific message point. The new narrator will inherit conversation history up to this message.
sourceDormantCommitOnly: Dormant chapters can only fork from a Git commit.
sourceSplitCommitFixed: File source is fixed to commit {{sha}}.
forkNavigatePrompt: Chapter "{{title}}" has been created. Go to its conversation?
splitChapterDesc: Create a prefix chapter holding the history up to this commit, keep the current chapter as the continuation, and create a new fork from the split point.
splitMissingCommit: Choose a commit before splitting the chapter.
splitUnsupported: Chapter split is not available in this backend runtime.
splitCompressedFallbackDesc: This backend does not generate an AI summary for compressed splits yet. It will use {{mode}} instead.
splitSuccess: Created new fork "{{title}}" from the split point.
splitWarningSummary: The split completed with {{warnings}} warning(s) and {{fallbacks}} fallback(s).
conflictsDescription: {{count}} file(s) have conflicts. You may proceed, and the AI narrator can help resolve them.
fastForwardDescription: Target branch has no divergent commits. Merge will fast-forward without creating a merge commit.
mergeReviewRequiredDesc: This chapter needs an approved review before it can be merged.
mergeReviewRequestChangesDesc: The latest review requested changes. Please address them before merging.
mergeDirtySource: Commit-mode merge needs a clean source chapter. Commit or stash its changes, or switch back to workspace merge.
mergeDirtyTarget: Commit-mode merge needs a clean target chapter. Commit or stash its changes, or switch back to workspace merge.
mergeModeSnapshotDesc: Merges the workspaces as they stand. Uncommitted changes are fine, and nothing is written to your git history.
mergeModeCommitDesc: Produces a real git merge commit you can push or run CI on. Both chapters must have a clean worktree.
cleanupSkippedReason: Skipped because it is already merged or abandoned, or has uncommitted changes. Re-run with Force to clean it up anyway.
reviewConclusionFailedDesc: The review conclusion could not be loaded, so approval cannot be confirmed. Retry, or merge anyway if you know it is approved.
batchMergeDescription: Start an async merge session that merges multiple source chapters into a target chapter. Progress and conflicts are reported through the narrator WebSocket.
batchMergeUnsupported: Batch merge is unavailable in this backend runtime.
cleanupDescription: Select chapters to abandon and clean up. This will remove worktrees and optionally delete branches.
cleanupConfirmMessage: You are about to clean up {{count}} selected chapter(s). This action cannot be undone.
